abstract: 259 patients with stage I non-seminomatous germ-cell testicular teratoma who were treated by orchidectomy alone and monitored at one often centres in the United Kingdom were followed for a median of 30 months. 62 of the 70 relapses occurred in the first 18 months after orchidectomy. The 2-year relapse-free rate was 74%, falling to 68% at 4 years. Histological sections from 233 of the orchidectomy specimens were reviewed centrally. Four features independently predicted relapses: invasion of testicular veins, invasion of testicular lymphatics, absence of yolk-sac elements, and presence of undifferentiated tumour. An index, based on the number of these features observed, identified a high-risk subgroup of 55 patients who had a 42% relapse-free rate at 2 years.
abstract_ja: 精巣摘除術単独で治療し経過観察した病期I非セミノーマ性精巣奇形腫の患者259例を、英国の10施設で中央値30か月追跡した。精巣摘除術標本のうち233例の組織切片を中央で再検討した。再発は70例で、そのうち62例は精巣摘除術後18か月以内に生じた。2年無再発率は74%、4年で68%であった。精巣静脈浸潤、精巣リンパ管浸潤、卵黄嚢成分の欠如、未分化腫瘍の存在の4つの因子が再発を独立して予測した。これらの因子の数に基づく指数により、2年無再発率42%の高リスク群55例が同定された。
